arms.coach: the same code, seeds, anchor targets, Sleeper usage deal and allocation noise; games by nfl_coach_sim through research.nfl_coach_dfs.coach_games on the caller's base tables
arms.engine: nfl_dfs_engine as shipped (ENV_SD, ATT_WEIGHT), games by nfl_deep_sim
arms.harness: research.nfl_dfs_engine_eval._week run twice a week; fit seasons 2023-2025; K 400

data: player-week DraftKings points for those weeks, built at the read by research.hist_data.build and passed with --table. No committed file holds a 2026 player-week after week 5.
dry_run: --dry plays 2026 weeks 2-5 (SEEN) end to end and writes no result; it must complete on the PC before the date. A fix it forces is committed with a NEW registration before any week 13-18 row is built.
independent_of: R1's verdict and the criterion-4 confirmatory test; run whatever they say

meaning.NOT ESTABLISHED: no DFS gain shown for coach-r1.0 on 96 games; the upper bound is printed; not re-read and not extended
meaning.PASS: eligible for a DFS shadow build; any production use is the owner's word and its own test
meaning.WORSE: the coaching engine is not used for DFS worlds as it stands

not_measurable: late-game usage: the deal sees a game's totals, not its plays (audit 2.6); that is R2

power.note: 0.006 and 0.017 are the gains the passing-volume anchor showed on 2026 and 2025
power.source: 0.0150 on 63 games for another pair of engine arms (nfl_dfs_engine.md), scaled

outcomes.NOT ESTABLISHED: guardrails hold, the primary does not

rule.primary: offence CRPS (roled player-weeks), coach minus engine, SE clustered by game: t < -t(0.975, games - 1)

same_games_as_r1: R1 reads game-level clock counts and the winner; this reads player points. The candidate is frozen and pinned in both registrations and neither read can change it, so neither informs the other. Its false-positive rate is its own (a DFS claim), not part of the win-probability family.
secondary_not_gating: the role-pair table (QB-WR, same-team stacks, cross-team) against real
world summary: attempts, completions, yards against Sleeper and real
what: independent DFS read: production's DFS worlds against worlds whose games the coaching engine plays
